title: Fibrewise density from a marked surjective smooth curve cover
statement: Let f:X→V be a scheme morphism, with a finite surjective cover ν:∐Y_i→X and commuting maps Y_i→B_i→T_i→V. Assume Y_i→B_i is an open immersion and B_i→T_i is smooth with geometrically connected residue fibres. Let W⊆X be open such that its inverse image in every Y_i surjects onto T_i. Then W is dense in every fibre of X→V, and its inverse image is dense in every fibre of Y_i→T_i. No properness, dimension bound, finiteness of T_i→V, or reducedness hypothesis is needed. Empty families are allowed. [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-scheme-fibre] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]

source.place: Tag 0GK7, final paragraph after making W_i→T_i surjective

proof.text: Each smooth fibre of B_i is regular and locally Noetherian. Geometric connectedness implies ordinary connectedness; a connected regular scheme is integral, in particular irreducible. Base change of the open immersion j_i embeds the Y_i fibre openly in this irreducible fibre, so the Y_i fibre is preirreducible. Surjectivity of the marked open onto T_i gives a nonempty open in every such fibre, which is therefore dense.

source.place: Tag 0GK7, final paragraph after making W_i→T_i surjective

proof.text: For any point x of a fibre X_v, lift x through ν and then a coproduct inclusion, to y∈Y_i. Set s=p_i(y). The fibre (Y_i)_s maps continuously to X_v by the commuting triangle, and y lifts to a point of this fibre. The density just proved puts this point in the closure of the marked open. Continuity takes its image x into the closure of W_v. Since x was arbitrary, W_v is dense. For empty families the covering condition makes X empty and the statement is vacuous. The proof uses actual residue fibres via their homeomorphisms to set-theoretic fibres.

theorem good_curves_fibre_density
    {X V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ V) (n : ℕ)
    (T Y B : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (t : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V)
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ B i) (p : ∀ i, B i ⟶ T i)
    (ν : (∐ Y) ⟶ X) [Surjective ν]
    (hcomm : ∀ i, Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν ≫ f = j i ≫ p i ≫ t i)
    (hj : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i))
    (hp : ∀ i, Smooth (p i))
    (hc : ∀ i (s : T i), GeometricallyConnected ((p i).fiberToSpecResidueField s))
    (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ i, Surjective (((Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ j i ≫ p i)) :
    (∀ v : V, Dense (f.fiberι v ⁻¹' (W : Set X))) ∧
    (∀ i (s : T i), Dense (((j i ≫ p i).fiberι s ≫ Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν) ⁻¹'
      (W : Set X)))
